risk_description: Trend definition may be ambiguous (what counts as "established")
mitigation: Frozen as 2+ consecutive HH/HL or LH/LL using N=5 swings — deterministic

risk_description: Same level may be swept multiple times creating apparent duplicate events
mitigation: One event per sweep — new trend required for new event — deterministic

risk_description: CHOCH confirmation timing may be unclear
mitigation: Defined as bar close beyond CHOCH swing — deterministic

risk_description: Entry retest may never occur (price moves away after CHOCH)
mitigation: Excluded events — no outcome bias — fill constraint enforced

risk_description: Low event count may prevent statistical inference
mitigation: Rare-event policy — CI-based evidence — no arbitrary minimum

risk_description: Cost assumption (2-point spread) may not reflect reality
mitigation: Labeled as researcher assumption — not claimed as observed — three-tier reporting

risk_description: Prior trend may be subjective in borderline cases
mitigation: Frozen as 2+ consecutive swings — any borderline cases excluded by construction

risk_description: CHOCH swing selection may be ambiguous (which HL to break)
mitigation: Defined as last HL/LH before sweep — deterministic

risk_description: Same-bar stop and entry may conflict
mitigation: M1 data handles via wick-based stop trigger — same as BOS+OB

risk_description: Event clustering may be more severe than estimated
mitigation: HAC with bandwidth=10 — if clustering proves severe Control Session may require day aggregation
